title: game/host-events.json
description: What each NPC host event does in the world (C08; schema 2 since VILLAGE_PLAN V02: a count on give_item, point_at_place and point_at_slot; V03: take_item and sell; V15: buy; W08: the teacher's kinds procedure_repeat, procedure_slower, procedure_help, give_missing, teach_recipe and start_procedure). Loaded by HostEventTable (Vocaterra.Game.Core).

item.description: An item by the name the save gives it (ItemDefinition).

count.description: How many: a number (one when left out), or qty, the number the learner said (the verdict's qty slot: 1 when none, 0 for cero, at most 5, so no talk makes gifts out of nothing).

instead.description: V21b: with asked. Catalogue nouns the NPC has something else for, by the suffix of the host event it answers instead of <npc>.wont_sell (pan: give_bread, so <npc>.give_bread). The agent takes that event with onHostEvent.

asked.description: V21: the catalogue nouns whose request this gift answers (agua, botella). A request for another noun raises <npc>.wont_sell to the agent as a host turn and nothing is given; a line with no noun, or a word the catalogue lacks, is read as a request for the gift.

oneOf.description: The NPC puts items in the inventory, all of them or none (the bottle once, whatever the count).
The beacon goes to the nearest block of a catalogue noun.
The beacon goes to a named place of the scene: a site, a point or a named prop (stall, river).
The beacon goes to the place the verdict's slot names (place): a label of the scene, else the nearest block of a catalogue noun; neither raises <npc>.unknown_place to the agent as a host turn.
The NPC takes items from the inventory, all of them or none (V03).

The NPC sells as many of the item as the learner asked for (the verdict's qty, one when none; no cap since V19, the coins and the bag are the bound) for that many times the price in coins. Otherwise nothing changes hands and a host turn is raised to the agent: another item (or a catalogue noun of no item) <npc>.wont_sell, none asked for <npc>.none_asked, too few coins <npc>.cant_pay (V03), no room in the bag for the items <npc>.no_room (V19).

The NPC buys the item from the learner (V15, the sale turned round): as many as the learner said (the verdict's qty, at most what the bag holds) or, with no number, every one the bag holds, for the price each in coins. A bag with none raises <npc>.cant_sell to the agent as a host turn, a line that offers another item (or a catalogue noun of no item) <npc>.wont_buy, an offer of none <npc>.none_offered, and a bag with no room for the coins <npc>.no_room (V19); then nothing changes hands.

A teacher's answer at a station (W08, design 10.14), with no more to say: procedure_repeat plays the instruction again, procedure_slower plays it slowly, procedure_help is the H key, and give_missing gives the ingredients the run still lacks (always for the first bake, then once per in-game day; the agent answers <npc>.nothing_missing, <npc>.gift_used or <npc>.no_room when nothing is given).

procedure.description: The procedure's id; left out, the procedure the NPC teaches (so a bundle with none maps the event and nothing happens).

oneOf.description: teach_recipe adds the procedure to the procedures the learner knows (W08); start_procedure opens the station for it and puts the teacher in its teaching state (the accepted offer to bake).
